id.description:
Central registry of the OpenAPI component schemas.

The schemas mirror the real payloads returned by the API Resources and the
ApiResponse support class, so the documentation stays in sync with the code.

body.example: I started working on this task.

Pagination.description: Pagination metadata returned by the task listing endpoint.

email: The email has already been taken.

AuthResponse.description: Authentication payload containing the Sanctum token.

ProjectsResponse.description: Response containing the list of projects of the authenticated user.

MembersResponse.description: Response containing the members of a project.

TasksResponse.description: Response containing a filtered and paginated list of tasks.

CommentResponse.description: Response containing a single comment (API Resource envelope).

CommentCollectionResponse.description: Paginated collection of comments (API Resource collection envelope).
